sar.narrative: This report details suspicious card-not-present activity involving customer C00854 and card account C00854-K2 identified on November 6, 2016. On that date at 16:35:06 UTC, an online transaction of $149.99 for product R was executed in region 299 under transaction ID 3435476. The transaction was conducted using device D000255, possessing the hardware profile 'KFFOWI Build/LVY48F | Android 5.1.1 | chrome generic | 1024x600'. Device D000255 was recorded as new to card account C00854-K2 and sharply deviated from the cardholder's historical baseline of in-person retail spending on an iOS device. Knowledge graph analysis revealed that device D000255 serves as the operational nexus of fraud ring 37749036, linking at least 18 cards across the institution. The device is tied directly to 14 prior confirmed fraudulent cases, including closed cases CC-5430, CC-4873, CC-4852, CC-4716, CC-4641, and CC-4613. Furthermore, device D000255 connects card C00854-K2 to card C06224-K2, an active ring member conducting unauthorized transactions within the same evaluation timeframe. Total suspicious exposure associated with transaction 3435476 on card C00854-K2 is $149.99. Card C00854-K2 has been escalated for case creation and connected cards have been placed on active monitoring to prevent further ring-related losses.
